name: tanyelai
description: One plugin: nullius, a harness that turns the unread paper, the unsearched literature and the unbounded critique into states a research session cannot finish in.

plugins.name: nullius
plugins.description: Outcome gates for research work: an unresolved citation cannot reach a draft, a claim cannot exceed its source's read depth, a status cannot exceed what author independence earns, and a critique that has run out of grounded findings must return a verdict rather than a longer list.
